name: Ierusalem: Anno Domini

categories.label: Score track (immediate points)
categories.hint: Immediate points gained during play: apostles, parables, favors, Sanhedrin criteria.

categories.label: Parable tiles collected
categories.hint: End bonus by number of parables: 1/2/3/4/5/6/7 = 1/3/6/10/13/15/18 VP.

categories.label: Followers seated at the Last Supper (net)
categories.labelVi: Người theo ở Bữa Tiệc Ly (ròng)
categories.hint: Sum over followers behind Jesus/apostles: start value (purple 4, orange 5, white 6, Jesus 7) minus 1 per seat of distance; behind Judas subtract 5/4/3. Corner followers count.

categories.label: Offering tokens in Warehouse
categories.hint: 1 VP per offering token in your Warehouse.

categories.label: Illumination tile still unused
categories.hint: 5 VP if the tile is still on your board.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who still has the Illumination tile
Tied player who has performed the most favors (further on the favor track)

notes: family: positional-seating. Game ends when the Sanhedrin token reaches the last space or a player seats their last follower. Seating value is computed on the board, so it is entered as a net number. 2-player variant removes 2 VP and 3 VP parables and uses friendly followers; not modelled.
